name: ClearCOGS
oneLiner: AI demand forecasting for restaurants that turns POS sales data into daily prep lists, ordering recommendations and alerts to cut food waste and overproduction.
bestFor: Restaurants and multi-unit groups, especially on Toast, that lose margin to overproduction, spoilage and guesswork in daily prep and ordering.

updates.text: Raised a $3.8 million seed round led by Closed Loop Partners to fund product development and customer acquisition.
Launched an open API that delivers its forecasts and prescriptive recommendations into restaurants' existing tools and workflows.

features: AI demand forecasts by menu item built from POS sales history
Daily prep lists and par recommendations
Alerts for likely stock-outs, price changes and unusual sales
Forecasts that also inform labor planning
Toast integration available through the Toast integrations marketplace
Open API to push forecasts into other restaurant systems

pricing.text: Custom pricing; ClearCOGS does not publish prices.

notes: No customers named publicly by the vendor or press could be confirmed from search results (search budget ran out before a dedicated customer search); leave customers out of the review. Toast support article 'Get Started with the ClearCOGS Integration' (https://support.toasttab.com/article/Get-Started-with-the-ClearCOGS-Integration, last updated 2026-03) confirms the Toast integration and mentions an SMB product with top-item forecasts and out-of-stock, price-change and unusual-sales reports. Sources disagree on HQ (Chicago vs Philadelphia area). Dropped from current review: 'typically a monthly subscription that scales with number of locations' (unverified).
